targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence_integrity_runs WHERE status = 'failed'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_export_requests WHERE status = 'pending_approval'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pii_access_audit WHERE was_masked = false
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance_access_reviews WHERE is_stale = true AND review_status IN ('open','in_review')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM governance_review_findings WHERE severity = 'critical'
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM evidence_integrity_runs GROUP BY status
SELECT failure_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM evidence_integrity_failures GROUP BY failure_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT pii_category, COUNT(*) as count FROM pii_access_audit GROUP BY pii_category ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as runs FROM evidence_integrity_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as time, COUNT(*) as requests FROM audit_export_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT review_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM retention_policy_versions GROUP BY review_status
SELECT tenant_scope, check_type, status, violations_found, cross_tenant_detected, created_at FROM tenant_isolation_validation_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT finding_type, severity, remediation_required, description, created_at FROM governance_review_findings ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT 'pii_access_always_logged' as check_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE was_masked = false AND masking_policy_applied = true) as policy_applied_unmasked FROM pii_access_audit UNION ALL SELECT 'review_findings_advisory', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_advisory = false) FROM governance_review_findings
